cve_summary: coders/jpeg.c in ImageMagick before 7.0.6-1 allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (application crash) or possibly have unspecified other impact via JPEG data that is too short.
docstring:
Summary: RegisterJPEGImage() adds JPEG image format properties to the supported formats list in the image processing library.

Parameters: N/A

Returns: size_t: the size of the registered JPEG image format entry.

Logic: The function initializes a version string and a description for the JPEG format. It creates a new MagickInfo entry for various JPEG-related identifiers (like "JPE", "JPEG", "JPG", "JPS", and "PJPEG") and sets properties such as decoder and encoder functions, thread support, and MIME type. The function checks the JPEG library version to conditionally set thread support and assigns a constant description string. Each entry is registered using RegisterMagickInfo, ensuring that the library can handle JPEG images appropriately. The function is designed to support both single and multi-frame JPEG files, as well as in-memory I/O operations.

reference_missing_steps: explicit memory allocation for MagickInfo entries
candidate_missing_steps: conditional thread support based on JPEG library version
judge_vs_vulnerable.rationale: Implementation 1 includes conditional thread support checks based on the JPEG library version and uses a static description string. It also uses a version string derived from the JPEG library version. Implementation 2 hardcodes thread support as false and uses a fixed version string. Implementation 1 includes conditional logic for thread support, which is absent in 2. Implementation 2 allocates memory for MagickInfo entries but does not free it, while 1 does not allocate memory in this way.

reference_missing_steps: explicit memory allocation for MagickInfo entries
initialization of MagickInfo with a struct literal including signature and default values
candidate_missing_steps: conditional thread support based on JPEG_LIB_VERSION
JPEG delegate check before assigning decoder/encoder functions
check that version string is non-empty before assignment
judge_vs_fixed.rationale: Implementation 1 includes conditional thread support based on the JPEG library version and checks for the JPEG delegate before assigning decoder and encoder functions. It also uses a static description string and ensures the version string is non-empty before assigning it. Implementation 2 hardcodes thread support as false and uses a fixed version string. It also allocates memory for each MagickInfo entry but does not include conditional checks for the JPEG library version or delegate. Implementation 1 performs more conditional validation and input checks.
